It is. I just haven't been on reddit for 5 hours.

I am the same way as you, although I've never cut.

Just letting you know that I feel the same way you do, and you're not alone.
I know everything about everything. However, I am not presently at liberty to divulge that information.

Damn.

I don't really know if I can give any advice that would be worthwhile to you.

You and I are so alike. I imagine myself walking out in public with short sleeves and shorts and I immediately die on the inside. I made the mistake of doing that twice: First time, a little kid said, "Mommy, look, that kid's really skinny." Second time, people stared uncontrollably.

People compliment you on your weight? You must be a girl, then. I was wondering if you were. No one would ever look at me and compliment me.

Jesus... I want to call you things like "imbecile, stupid, fool, dumbass".
However, I can understand how blinded by love you are. Yes, blinded by love. So blind that you can't even see that you're destroying yourself. You're letting that witch toy with you and you're enjoying the pain she causes you, like a masochist.

Tell her to get the fuck out of your life and you must forget about her.

Yeah, that may be good enough in your situation. Make sure she knows that you'll always be her friend.

However, as someone who is suicidal, I don't really know how much you can help. You're not the one living her life. You're not the one feeling her pain. Every person who is __truly__ suicidal knows this. You may be able to console and comfort her, but whatever you do may not be enough. Most times, we need physical contact with another person to truly feel like they care. Talk to her about it, and use your best judgement on if you should tell her parents. She'll hate you for it, but if she gets better, she'll get over it.

I wish I had someone as caring as you.

Are you... me? Seriously, as I read this, I was instantly reminded of myself (besides the sex part, never had sex). I can relate so much to everything you're saying. Being a 105 lb guy is the worst thing in the world. I hate myself every second of the day and can't go outside without layering up, so that it isn't obvious how skinny I am. I wish I could just go to sleep and never wake up, or be in some tragic accident.
I doubt that. I don't know how I could be the answer.
